# Prompt registry

Sources: `prompts/<name>/v<N>/`; PLAN.md 6.0 to 6.7; register N87, N110, D11, D15.

Each prompt version is a directory of files; `HASH` pins their content (SHA-256 over every other file of the directory,
in name order). A change to a released version is a new version directory. The extraction cache key uses the prompt id
and `schema_version` together with the render hash of the variables (`internal/prompts` `ExtractionKey`).

## Inputs

- `consolidate_route/v1`: candidates, capacity_note, facts, observations_mission. Untrusted: facts, candidates.
- `consolidate_write/v1`: attached, mode, previous, sources. Untrusted: previous, sources, attached.
- `dedup_adjudicate/v1`: a, b. Untrusted: a, b.
- `extract/v1`: chunk_count, chunk_index, content, context, entity_hints_section, header, item_timestamp,
  metadata_section, retain_mission_preamble, retain_mission_section. Untrusted: content, context, header,
  metadata_section, entity_hints_section.
- `page/v1`: added, changed, document, retired, topic. Untrusted: topic, document, added, changed, retired.
- `page_full/v1`: evidence, max_tokens, topic. Untrusted: topic, evidence.
- `reflect/v1`: directives, directives_reminder, disposition_section, max_iterations, mission, now. Untrusted: none.
- `reflect_structured/v1`: answer, question, schema. Untrusted: question, schema, answer.
- `summarize/v1`: head, outline, tail, title. Untrusted: title, outline, head, tail.
